description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's handling of Unicode normalization forms (NFD/NFC). It sets up test cases to verify Git's behavior with filenames and file contents containing decomposed and precomposed Unicode characters, particularly in the context of macOS precomposition. It includes configuration, creation of test files, execution of tests for various Git commands, and utility functions related to Unicode normalization testing.

methods.name: ls_files_nfc_nfd
methods.description: A shell function that configures Git to test Unicode precomposition handling by creating repositories with specific precomposeunicode settings and comparing file listings and diffs under different configurations.
